notes.title: Announcement of Switch version package sales and event participation
notes.content:
Thank you for enjoying Sudoku Classic.
 
[Packaging the Nintendo Switch version]
Our Sudoku series, including Sudoku Classic, will be sold as packaged software for Nintendo Switch.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43614169/e451031dd93ffac040e043613b7bc7c296293366.jpg

* Release date
March 27, 2025

* Title
Sudoku Relax & Classic -Seasons Collection-
© RucKyGAMES / published by G-MODE Corporation.

https://gmodecorp.com/cs/numberplace-collection

Sales are only in Japan.


[Event information]

We will be introducing our Sudoku Relax & Classic package software for Nintendo Switch at G-MODE's space at "TOKYO INDIE GAMES SUMMIT2025" to be held in Kichijoji, Tokyo from March 8th to 9th! You can also try out the software.

If you are going to the same event, please come to the G-MODE space!

notes.title: Fixed the refresh rate that can be finished with the gamepad. Ver 1.1.4
notes.content:
* Enabled to end the game from the game putts while playing with the game putts.( LB + RB press at the same time on the title screen)
 * Fixed the timer during play to be the correct number of seconds, no matter how many Hz refresh rate is.
 * I made other fine adjustments.
 
 
 This modification will not affect your progress to the game.

notes.title: Announcement of the release date of the Switch version of "Sudoku Classic 2".
notes.content:
Thank you for enjoying Sudoku Classic.

We are pleased to announce that the sequel to Sudoku Classic, "Sudoku Classic 2", has been released for Nintendo Switch.

While retaining the customizability and operability of the original Sudoku Classic...

* The design has been completely renewed.

* New background music has been added! A total of 5 songs.

・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・
